data.title: Always on, always listening: New AI devices are pushing legal limits and could put users in jeopardy
data.description: AI always-listening wearables from Apple, Amazon, Meta and other startups are getting creative with privacy rules and fueling concerns about covert recordings.
data.author: MacKenzie Sigalos,Annie Palmer
